delta.comment: PR #325 review-fix (2026-08-10). SHIPMENT SAFETY: 117-F removed from the 124-S manifest. backlogit ShipShipment gates both destructive covering-feature operations - setArtifactStatus(feature, done) and the collectArchiveCandidateIDs sweep (feature + descendants + linked deliberations) - on EXPLICIT manifest membership (explicitScope, backlogit 133-F/133.004-T), so closing S1 would have marked 117-F done AND archived it while 14 of its 19 children remained queued in 125-S/126-S. All three Plan-1 shipments are now uniformly TASK-ONLY: 124-S = 5 tasks, 125-S = 6 tasks, 126-S = 8 tasks (19 total); 117-F is a member of NO manifest and REMAINS QUEUED until all 19 children and all three shipments complete. Hardening gained H10.4; review gained F13 (P0, RESOLVED) and F14 (P1, RESOLVED-with-mitigation). RESIDUAL F14 for Ship: returnUnreleasedFeatureItems is NOT gated by explicitScope and clears parent_id on a non-member ancestor feature's unreleased descendants, so closing 124-S will orphan 117.006-T..117.019-T from 117-F (recoverable relationship change only - no closure, no archival, no data loss); Ship MUST re-adopt them under 117-F via adopt_item after closing 124-S and again after 125-S, and verify parentage before claiming the next shipment. NEVER re-add 117-F to a manifest.

SUPERSEDES THE EARLIER "NEVER re-add 117-F to a manifest" INSTRUCTION IN THIS LOG (2026-08-10 cycle-3 redesign, H10.5). The prior event is preserved verbatim as history and must not be rewritten; this event is the CURRENT close contract for log-based consumers.

WHY IT CHANGED. The earlier instruction was correct for the topology it was written against: 117-F was then a covering feature with 19 children spread across three task-only manifests (124-S/125-S/126-S), so any manifest membership would have triggered the destructive covering-feature path while children were still queued. That topology was REPLACED, not patched. Task-only membership turned out to be insufficient anyway: returnUnreleasedFeatureItems is NOT gated by explicitScope and also runs for a NON-MEMBER ANCESTOR feature discovered by the featureScopeRoots upward parent_id walk, so closing 124-S would still have cleared parent_id on all 14 downstream tasks (reproduced on the real engine: ARM A orphans 14/14). The recorded Ship-side adopt_item repair was rejected as a P-010 role-boundary violation.

CURRENT TOPOLOGY AND CONTRACT. 117-F is now a CHILDLESS product umbrella. Its former children were re-parented to three ROOT per-shipment covering features - 118-F (127-S), 119-F (128-S), 120-F (129-S) - each FULLY COVERED by and an EXPLICIT MEMBER of its own manifest, with origin_feature=117-F provenance retained on every task and all 27 blocks edges preserved. 117-F is grouped to the three by related_to links (non-hierarchical) and is an INTENTIONAL EXPLICIT MEMBER of the FINAL shipment 129-S, where it is closed engine-natively.

That is safe precisely because 117-F is childless and root: featureScopeRoots cannot escape upward from it, and returnUnreleasedFeatureItems iterates an EMPTY remainder, so the cascade the old instruction guarded against is STRUCTURALLY IMPOSSIBLE rather than merely avoided. Proven end to end against the real backlogit 1.8.0 engine: returned_ids=[] on all three closes, 64/64 and 196/196 assertions, zero non-archived residue.

DO: leave 117-F as a member of 129-S and close it with a single `backlogit shipment ship` as part of that shipment. DO NOT: re-add 117-F to 127-S or 128-S, give it children, or call adopt_item / re-parent / reactivate at any point - post-close backlog repair is neither required nor permitted (P-010). A non-empty returned_ids on any close is a REGRESSION: halt and escalate to Stage.

See docs/compound/097-S-shipment-task-only-safe-close.md ("Reconciliation - the FULLY-COVERED ROOT exception") for which contract applies to which manifest shape, and docs/spikes/2026-08-09-plan1-shipment-topology-proof/ for the executable evidence.

NOTE: this is a close-path contract correction only. It does NOT clear the six open P1s (F16-F21) that currently gate all three shipments - no shipment is safely claimable yet.
